crossRefs.note: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

translations.web: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
translations.bsb: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”
translations.kjv: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
translations.asv: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
